Large fixture is 64 MiB padding, not representative package/filesystem diversity.
CPU and RSS describe scanner child processes, not all container/provider usage.
Managed probes use production scanner classes with synthetic repository authority, not the entire registry integration.
Local clean and large fixture suites overlapped; not multi-tenant load qualification.
Current source hashes were captured after benchmark runs. Later changes added packaging guards, staged activation and a bounded fixture broker; these timings are not measurements of those updates.
No filesystem snapshots, general workflow executor, CI evidence import or production scale qualification.
